news.headline: OSS Awarded $2.75 Million Contract by U.S. Army to Develop Next-Generation Compute Appliance for Tactical Ground Vehicles
news.summary: The U.S. Army awarded OSS a $2.75M contract to develop a next-generation compute appliance for tactical ground vehicles. It extends OSS's existing rugged-edge work for Army vehicle programs and adds to its defense pipeline.

news.headline: Lake Street Maintains Buy on One Stop Systems, Cuts Target to $15
news.summary: Lake Street kept its Buy rating after Q3 but lowered its price target to $15. Like A.G.P., it pointed to lower valuation multiples and near-term margin pressure.

news.headline: One Stop Systems Reports Q3 2026 Results
news.summary: Continuing-operations revenue rose about 36% to $12.6M, with year-to-date book-to-bill of 1.46. Full-year growth guidance was raised to about 40%, but a bad-debt charge and a legal settlement deepened the quarterly loss.

news.headline: One Stop Systems Launches $50M At-The-Market Equity Offering With Piper Sandler
news.summary: OSS signed an equity distribution agreement letting it sell up to $50M of common stock over time through Piper Sandler. This adds potential dilution, and the stock slid after the release.

news.headline: A.G.P. Maintains Buy on One Stop Systems, Cuts Target to $16
news.summary: After Q3, A.G.P. kept its Buy rating but lowered its price target to $16, reflecting margin pressure and lower valuation multiples.

news.headline: One Stop Systems Expands Enterprise AI Market Opportunity with Qualification for Tier 1 Global Computing Platform Provider
news.summary: OSS's Gen5 4UP-MAX expansion system, which adds up to eight 675W AI accelerators to existing servers, was qualified with an unnamed tier-1 enterprise computing platform provider. This opens a channel into enterprise AI and data-center deployments.

catalysts.label: SC26 Supercomputing conference
catalysts.detail: OSS has typically exhibited high-performance compute and PCIe expansion products at SC (it launched its Gen 6 line at SC25). SC26 runs mid-November.

catalysts.label: Q4/FY2026 results
catalysts.detail: Expected around March 2027; date not announced. Watch whether ~40% FY growth guidance is met and whether the ATM is used.

pulse: OSS is growing again: Q3 revenue rose about 36% to $12.6M and FY2026 growth guidance was raised to around 40%, and on Nov 9 it won a $2.75M U.S. Army contract for a next-generation tactical-vehicle compute appliance, following a new tier-1 enterprise AI qualification; AAII reported a ~7.7% share gain after the award. The stock is still well below its summer levels after the post-Q3 selloff on margin strain, one-off charges and a new $50M ATM that adds dilution risk, while analysts keep Buy ratings with trimmed targets (A.G.P. $16, Lake Street $15). SC26 in mid-November is the next showcase, and Q4 results around March 2027 will test the ~40% growth guide.
